recognize_zh: 兩格圖中的嗜酸性球（左為分葉成熟型，右為較大的嗜酸性骨髓細胞）細胞質內橘紅色嗜酸性顆粒之間混雜許多大而深紫色、類似嗜鹼性的顆粒，呈「雙色」外觀，即 harlequin cell（異常嗜酸性球），常與 inv(16) AML 相關。
features: Eosinophil lineage cells containing a mixture of orange-pink eosinophilic granules and large dark purple-violet basophilic-appearing granules
Left: mature-sized cell with a trilobed nucleus and admixed dark purple and pinkish granules
Right: larger immature eosinophil (myelocyte-stage) with a round-indented nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Coarse, variably sized granules overlie the nucleus in the immature cell
Background red cells and platelets without notable abnormality
describe_en: Bone marrow smear (two panels) shows eosinophil-lineage cells containing a mixture of typical orange-pink eosinophilic granules and large, dark purple-violet, basophil-like granules. The left panel shows a segmented eosinophil with a trilobed nucleus, and the right panel shows a larger immature eosinophil with a round to indented nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm with granules overlying the nucleus. These abnormal eosinophils with metachromatic granules (harlequin cells) are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with CBFB::MYH11 [inv(16)/t(16;16)] in the appropriate context, and cytogenetic or molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Normal early eosinophils may contain a few basophilic-staining primary granules, but these are few and small rather than numerous large dark purple granules in otherwise mature eosinophils.
Basophils have uniformly dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus without an admixed orange-pink eosinophilic granule population.

ddx.dx: Eosinophilia in CML or myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia (PDGFRA)
ddx.vs: These may show dysplastic eosinophils with mixed granules too, so distinction requires BCR::ABL1, PDGFRA/B, FGFR1 or CBFB::MYH11 testing.
Mast cells are round-to-oval cells with a central round nucleus and dense purple granules only, lacking eosinophilic granules and nuclear lobation.
